title: Iridium–Schiff base complex-based fluorimetric turn-off sensor and HPLC-DAD analytical approaches for quantitation of 8-hydroxy-2′-deoxyguanosine as an oxidative DNA damage biomarker in biofluids of healthy and diabetic subjects
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28931-28942
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02144A, Paper
Open Access

Hazim M. Ali, Tamer H. A. Hasanin, Ahmed Hamad Alanazi, Emad Manni, Moamen S. Refat, Azza H. Rageh, Mohammed Gamal
8-OHdG selectively quenches Ir-SB complex fluorescence over a broad linear range. Native spectrofluorimetry and chromatographic methods were applied for the determination of 8-OHdG in biofluids from healthy volunteers and diabetic patients.
